description: This Java class `PolicyModifyResponseSignalMapper` maps policy modification response signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter, handling validation, topic path building, and payload enhancement for policy modify command responses.

classes.name: PolicyModifyResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: Final class implementing signal mapping for policy modification responses, extending `AbstractModifySignalMapper` and implementing `ResponseSignalMapper`.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the response class name ends with 'Response'; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns a `TopicPathBuilder` for the given policy modify command response.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with status code and optional value from the command response.
